'''Shaneo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a crafting equipment [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] he ran a stall within the Republic controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]. Shaneo had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and tanned skin. While at his stall he wore white and grey [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shaneo first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. In the game he serves as a Republic crew skills vendor on Corellia. His location is marked in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', but his name is given as "Shane Rylo".
